name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, lower the bar to mid-chest, then press up to full arm extension.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: On an incline bench, press dumbbells from shoulder height to full extension above the chest.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Lower the body toward the floor keeping a straight line from head to heels, then push back up.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Hinge at the hips to grip the bar, keep a neutral spine, and stand up by driving through the floor.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip and pull the chin above the bar.

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back and row the bar toward the lower ribcage.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Pull the bar down toward the upper chest while keeping the torso upright.

name: Overhead Barbell Press
instructions: Press the bar from shoulder height to full overhead extension without arching the lower back.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells out to the sides until arms are roughly parallel with the floor.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Curl the bar from full arm extension up to shoulder height, keeping elbows fixed at the sides.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Curl dumbbells with a neutral grip, keeping the wrists straight throughout the movement.

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Using a cable machine, extend the arms downward until fully straight, then return with control.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Bench press with a shoulder-width grip, keeping elbows tucked close to the body.

name: Back Squat
instructions: With the bar on the upper back, squat down until thighs are parallel to the floor, then stand back up.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Push the platform away using the legs until nearly extended, avoiding locking the knees.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward into a lunge, lowering the back knee toward the floor, and alternate legs while walking.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a slight knee bend, lowering the bar along the legs, then return to standing.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: With upper back supported on a bench, drive the hips upward until the body forms a straight line.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Rise up onto the toes as high as possible, then lower the heels back down with control.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold a straight-line position on the forearms and toes, bracing the core throughout.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar and raise the legs toward the chest while keeping the core braced.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Carry a heavy weight in each hand for a set distance while maintaining an upright posture.
